title: NexTile Window Overrides
description: Configuration for window-specific tiling behavior in NexTile GNOME extension

wmClass.description: Window class to match. Use 'xprop WM_CLASS' or GNOME Looking Glass to find. Exact match (case-sensitive); comma-separates a list of exact classes.

wmTitle.description: Window title to match (optional). Supports: substring matching, '!' prefix for negation, comma-separated values for multiple patterns.

wmId.description: Specific window ID (runtime use only, added by keyboard shortcut - not for manual configuration)

mode.description: float = window will not be tiled (stays floating), tile = force window to tile even if it would normally float

launchRules.description: Per-application launch placement. The first matching rule decides where a newly launched window opens, and applies even when launch-new-workspace-enabled is off.

wmClass.description: Window class to match. Exact match (case-sensitive); comma-separates a list of exact classes.

wmTitle.description: Window title to match (optional). Same matching as overrides: substring, '!' negation, comma-separated values.

workspace.description: new = a fresh workspace, current = stay on the active workspace, a number = that workspace counted from 1 (a new workspace when it does not exist yet)
